text: 1. Objectives of the Program This program attempts to foster advanced talents who not only adhere to socialist political line, but also master solid knowledge of information management and adapt themselves to new circumstances of reform and changeable environment. According to the requirements of the discipline, candidates are expected to have a good grasp of basic theories and methodologies in information science, and acquire systematic and profound specialized knowledge; to keep abreast of the latest study at home and abroad concerning information management; to be familiar with relevant government policies and business customs; to be competent in analyzing and solving problems; to be open-minded, initiative and practical; to be proficient in a foreign language; to be capable of computer application and to obtain preliminary knowledge in economy, finance and enterprise management. The graduates are apt for mid-line or senior job of information management in universities, research institutes and enterprises. 2. Duration of the Program 3 years for master's degree candidates. 3. Main Interests 1) The Theory and Methodology for Information Application 2) Technology of Information Services 3) Information Management for Intellectual Property 4) Enterprises Intelligence 4. Scientific Research and Degree Dissertation 5.1. Proposal 1) Theme The theme of dissertation must be relevant with frontiers or cross-sectional fields concerning national economy in major research 2) Prerequisites Candidates are required to obtain the required credits and submit at least 4000 words literature reading report 3) Requirements Candidates must submit a proposal concerning dissertation within the second semester of the second year after enrollment, including literature review, the meaning of the dissertation, research aim, difficulties and features, would-be innovations, etc. and at least 30 references, of which at least 10 references of foreign researchers. 4) Check and Approval Public presentation must be held to check the proposal by major tutor board (at least 3 including at least 1 professor) The writing of dissertation can be prepared after the pass of the check 5.2. In-progress Report In the course of writing, candidates should submit reports concerning dissertation so as to ensure the dissertation may proceed as schedule. If the spread is large , advice will be given. 5.3. Oral defense of the dissertation 1) Qualifications After dissertation has been firstly checked by the tutor after accomplishment and a paper has been published in core journals, a pre-oral defense can be applied for. 2) Pre-oral defense This defense is held before correspondence and conducted by the major tutor board. If the check is successful, the student could hand the dissertation to correspondence after necessary revision following suggestions of the board, and if failed, a modification or a rewriting is required. 3) Correspondence and Oral Defense Dissertation should be checked by 5 experts in specialty in the form of correspondence(both student and tutor's names are concealed for at least 2 experts) Oral defense can be held with all experts' agreements after the dissertation has been modified following the suggestions of experts. If the oral defense fails, the dissertation should be dealt with according to regulations made by Graduate Department of the University.
